1. (Currently amended) A method of providing advertisements in a traffic message comprising:
- obtaining traffic data having a traffic condition of a location description on a road network using a processor;
- assessing a location reference code associated with the location description assigned by a traffic message supplier using the processor;
- assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code using the processor;
- determining whether the advertising reference code is present using the processor;
- wherein the advertising reference code is determined based on a real-time assessment that includes evaluating whether an advertisement is available and suitable for the location reference code at a time of transmission.

2. (Original)

3. (Currently amended) The method according to Claim 1 further comprising:
- generating a traffic message having the location reference code when the advertising reference code is not present, wherein the traffic message is generated without an associated advertising reference code.

4. (Original)

6. (Currently amended) The method according to Claim 1 further comprising, prior to assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code:
- determining whether the traffic message is a message of every predefined number of messages for broadcast using the processor;
- generating a traffic message having the location reference code when the traffic message is a message of every predefined number of messages for broadcast, wherein the determination is based on a count of messages processed by the processor.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus for providing advertisements in a traffic message, the apparatus comprising:
- a processor configured to execute instructions to perform the method of Claim 1;
- a memory coupled to the processor, wherein the memory stores traffic data, location reference codes, and advertising reference codes;
- a communication interface coupled to the processor for receiving traffic data and transmitting traffic messages.

14. (Currently amended) A method of providing advertisement messages using location reference codes comprising:
- assessing a location reference code of a location description using a processor;
- assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code using the processor;
- generating an advertising message having the advertising reference code using the processor, wherein the advertising message is generated only when an advertisement is determined to be available and suitable for the location reference code;
- providing the advertising message for broadcast to navigation systems using the processor.

15. (Original)

16. (Currently amended) The method according to Claim 14, wherein the advertising messages are sent every predefined number of messages for broadcast, and wherein the predefined number is determined by the processor based on a count of messages processed.

25. (Currently amended) A method of providing advertisements comprising:
- generating a message having an advertising reference code using a processor, wherein the advertising reference code is determined based on a real-time assessment of advertisement availability;
- providing the message for broadcast to navigation systems using the processor, wherein the advertising reference code comprises a substantially unique code that identifies at least a portion of an advertisement stored and displayed on a recipient device of the message, and wherein the message is generated only when an advertisement is determined to be suitable for broadcast.

- presenting the at least one advertisement to a user of the navigation system at a location based on the location reference code using a display device coupled to the processor.
